consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance was energetic and featured some standout moments, particularly in the second set. The collaboration with the Neville Brothers added a unique flavor to the show, though some felt the first set was uneven.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 19 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While there were highlights and a strong second set, the unevenness of the first set and some lyrical issues led to a more tempered overall enthusiasm.
